items.difficulty_reason: Executed: scheme-theoretic identities V cap W = Delta^{-1}(V x W) and Delta(V cap W) = Delta ∩ (V x W) give (1); (2) compares coefficients via the Tor descriptions of both sides, equated at xi by the complete affine-local sub-claim of the tor-and-diagonal lemma and the length-independence lemma; (3) is pr_{1,*} ∘ Delta_* = id via the compose-pushforward lemma (chow-homology-backed).
